notes: SR157 AmbienteDirect. Tier 1 direct HTTP (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome), no block. Two candidates found and both excluded/dropped after inspection: (1) '/en/sale' (https://www.ambientedirect.com/en/sale) - mega-nav item 'Sale', title 'Sale | AmbienteDirect', breadcrumb/H1 'Sale', header shows '40 of 1182 products'. This is a generic cross-category percent-off promotional listing (every item carries price_original vs discounted price + 'saving' field in its GA4 tracking JSON); no clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/permanent-markdown copy anywhere on the page. Sampled the embedded GA4 item tracking data: only 1 of the visible product blocks carried an item_variant text mentioning 'discontinued item' (an isolated per-SKU note, not a page-level signal) - not enough to override the page's own generic 'Sale' branding. Per CLEARANCE VS SALE test, excluded as a temporary promotional sale, not recorded as an ambiguous row because the site draws its own explicit distinction (see next item). (2) '/en/outlet' (https://www.ambientedirect.com/en/outlet) - a SEPARATE, genuine site-taxonomy category confirming that distinction: own breadcrumb 'Outlet', page H1 'Outlet', SEO title 'Outlet | Design Shop | AmbienteDirect.com', dataLayer category name 'outlet' / translated_name 'Outlet', pageType 'subcategory'. However the page currently returns ZERO products: server-rendered empty-state text 'Es wurden leider keine Produkte gefunden' (no products found) and embedded ItemList JSON-LD numberOfItems:'0'. Per the qty rule, zero-product listings are dropped rather than emitted as qty:0 - Outlet is a real clearance-equivalent concept on this site but has no live inventory right now. Also checked: mega-nav for Restposten/Raeumung/Ausverkauf-labelled items (none besides Sale/Offers), sitemap (categories/other/filter_pages, all locales-in-English sitemap) for clearance/outlet keywords (only /en/outlet itself, no other hits), and site search for 'clearance' (generic search-results template, not a dedicated PLP), 'raeumung'/'restposten'/'ausverkauf' (all zero search results). No qualifying non-empty Clearance/Outlet PLP exists at present.
